E_NOTE_BODY_TOO_LARGE.message: This clip exceeds the 1 MB Markdown limit. Select a smaller section.

E_HTTP_RATE_LIMITED.message: Too many requests. Try again shortly.

E_BOOK_NOT_FOUND.message: Notebook unavailable. Reopen the clipper to refresh notebooks.
